facts.value: The University Computer Center (HRZ) provides students with the necessary IT for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.). It also offers advice and support for technical problems.
The Goethe University telephone hotline helps with questions regarding applications, semester dates, re-registration, changing subjects, double degree studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.

The International Student Services provide international students with information on topics such as residence permits, German courses, financing, studying successfully, careers, and more. Support and advice can also be obtained here.

The Student Services (Studierendenwerk) support students in social and economic matters, ensuring that students have the necessary infrastructure to study successfully through training assistance, student housing, cafeterias, and advisory services.
